name: Impulsora del Desarrollo y el Empleo en America Latina, S.A.B. de C.V.
summary: Impulsora del Desarrollo y el Empleo en América Latina, S.A.B. de C.V., through its subsidiaries, engages in the infrastructure and engineering businesses in Mexico. It is involved in the construction, operation, and maintenance of road concessions; operation of wastewater treatment plants, multimodal terminals for passenger transport, and hydroelectric power plants; and provision of electronic toll services. The company also leases medical equipment for hospitals and equipment for universities; develops prison infrastructure; and offers electronic parking payment system services. Impulsora del Desarrollo y el Empleo en América Latina, S.A.B. de C.V. was founded in 2005 and is headquartered in Mexico City, Mexico.
